events.speaker: FAUSTINA
events.text: Slower than that. Slower than feels right to you. Don't swat, don't breathe hard across the top of them, and don't stand between me and the box. They are not angry, they are lost, and a lost colony will follow her queen into a fence post if nobody sets down somewhere better for her to go.

events.speaker: FAUSTINA
events.text: All three queens are boxed, and the flyers will find their own way back before dusk. You did not hurry me one time. I have been helped by men who cost me a whole colony trying to be quick about it, and they meant well too.

events.speaker: FAUSTINA
events.text: I'll come, and the hives come with me. The tailgate of the second wagon will hold them, and I'll want one quiet morning wherever we stop for water.

events.speaker: FAUSTINA
events.text: Bees teach you to wait on a thing without deciding it is late. I have been waiting on you the same way, and there's honey at the end of it either road, so I don't mind.
